questions.question: Which event is associated with the beginning of the Great Depression in the United States?
choices: Stock market crash of 1929
Oil embargo of 1973
Panic of 1819
Stock market crash of 1987

questions.question: Who was president when the 1929 stock market crash occurred?
choices: Franklin D. Roosevelt
Woodrow Wilson
Herbert Hoover
Harry Truman

questions.question: What term describes a widespread decline in the general price level?
choices: Inflation
Reflation
Stagflation
Deflation

questions.question: What was a bank run?
choices: A bank expanding branches across a city
Many depositors trying to withdraw money at once
A government increasing income taxes
A bank selling only foreign currency

questions.question: Which region was strongly affected by the Dust Bowl?
choices: Great Plains
Pacific Northwest rainforests
New England coast
Great Lakes shoreline

questions.question: What were Hoovervilles?
choices: Federally built suburban developments
New towns reserved for bank employees
Informal settlements built by people who had lost housing
Military camps for returning veterans

questions.question: What did buying stock on margin involve?
choices: Purchasing shares only with gold coins
Borrowing part of the money used to purchase stock
Buying government bonds without interest
Receiving shares as unemployment payments

questions.question: Why could bank failures deepen the Depression?
choices: They guaranteed higher household spending
They eliminated all business debts automatically
They increased public confidence in financial institutions
They destroyed savings and restricted access to credit

questions.question: Why did falling consumer spending contribute to unemployment?
choices: Businesses reduced production and laid off workers
Businesses needed more workers to meet rising demand
Lower spending forced wages to rise nationwide
Consumers substituted borrowing for every lost purchase

questions.question: Why is the stock market crash alone an incomplete explanation of the Depression?
choices: Economic problems began only after World War II
The crash affected only foreign investors
Banking weaknesses, falling demand, and other factors also mattered
American banks remained entirely unaffected

questions.question: How did drought and soil damage contribute to Dust Bowl migration?
choices: Farm productivity increased enough to employ every migrant
Many farming families lost livelihoods and moved elsewhere
The federal government prohibited interstate travel
All farmers received new land without cost

questions.question: What effect did high protective tariffs have on international trade during the Depression?
choices: They eliminated retaliatory tariffs by other countries
They created a worldwide free-trade agreement
They required all nations to share a currency
They contributed to trade restrictions and reduced commerce

questions.question: Why did business investment fall during the Depression?
choices: Weak sales and uncertainty discouraged expansion
Every factory operated at full capacity
Borrowing became unnecessary for every business
Foreign governments purchased all unsold goods

questions.question: What made unemployment especially damaging before broad federal relief programs?
choices: All workers received permanent pensions from employers
Food and housing were supplied freely nationwide
Many households lacked dependable income support
State governments guaranteed jobs to every adult

questions.question: How did the Depression affect countries beyond the United States?
choices: Foreign economies were entirely disconnected from U.S. markets
Declining trade and financial connections spread economic distress
Only countries using dollars could experience unemployment
Every European economy expanded continuously throughout the 1930s

questions.question: A factory loses customers, lays off workers, and then loses more customers. What does this show?
choices: An economic downturn can reinforce itself
Unemployment necessarily increases consumer demand
Falling sales guarantee immediate wage increases
Factory closures always end recessions

questions.question: Which evidence best measures the Depression's impact on workers?
choices: The number of presidential campaign slogans
The size of military parades
The number of state capitals
Changes in unemployment and earnings

questions.question: Which distinction between the Dust Bowl and the Depression is accurate?
choices: The Depression affected only farmers; the Dust Bowl affected only bankers
Both were names for the same stock exchange collapse
The Dust Bowl involved environmental damage; the Depression was a broad economic crisis
The Dust Bowl occurred entirely after World War II

questions.question: Which source would best reveal a family's experience of unemployment in 1932?
choices: A map of colonial settlement in 1750
A diary describing job searches and household expenses
A treaty signed after the War of 1812
A weather report from 1990

questions.question: Which sequence places these Great Depression events in chronological order?
choices: 1929 crash, Roosevelt's 1933 inauguration, U.S. entry into World War II
Roosevelt's 1933 inauguration, 1929 crash, U.S. entry into World War II
U.S. entry into World War II, 1929 crash, Roosevelt's 1933 inauguration
1929 crash, U.S. entry into World War II, Roosevelt's 1933 inauguration
